note: Accepted risks. A waiver silences one rule for one file (or prefix) until it expires. Expired waivers stop working, so a stale exception cannot hide forever.

schema.file: path prefix the waiver applies to

waivers.reason: Documentation example: the webhook exists to demo file extraction, not to be deployed. If it is ever copied into a real workflow, the waiver does not follow the copy - the new path is scanned fresh.
